apps.name: Ghost Remote
apps.subtitle: Terminals on your other devices
apps.localizedDescription:
Ghost Remote opens terminals on your iPhone, iPad, or Mac running iGhostVT, from an iPhone or iPad without custom firmware.

Turn on remote access on the device running iGhostVT, then tap + in Ghost Remote and pair with the six-digit code it shows. Terminals open over your local network, or from anywhere through a relay you run yourself.

Both devices need the same release line — the first two numbers of the version match, as 1.4.1 and 1.4.7 do.
